text: まいごの　まいごの…　おこさま　かな？
note: This echoes the opening of the well-known children's song 犬のおまわりさん ("The Dog Policeman"), which begins まいごのまいごのこねこちゃん, "the lost, lost little kitten". The grunt swaps in おこさま ("little kiddie") to mock the player; the English put "little mouse" instead.
claim: The Japanese children's song 犬のおまわりさん (Inu no Omawarisan) begins with the lyric まいごのまいごのこねこちゃん.
